# PromptPack

> PromptPack (promptpack.tech) is a digital shop run by Ornalens LLP, India. It sells editable AI prompt packs and illustrated PDF field guides for websites, personal finance, social media and video. 5 products have purchase routes, including 3 complete guide editions with free sample prompts.

Updated: 2026-10-28. All products are digital downloads used with the buyer's own AI tools. They do not include AI credits, software subscriptions, recorded courses or publishing services.

## Available now

- [Money Audit Pack](https://promptpack.tech/finance): Find recurring charges in your billing emails. Turn them into a Keep / Review / Compare / Negotiate action plan with your AI assistant. Gmail setup + audit prompts + review worksheets. US$19, or ₹1,599 · one time.
- [75+ 3D Website Prompts](https://promptpack.tech/products/website-prompts/): Create 3D-style websites, landing pages, portfolios and SaaS with editable prompts and motion references. Pick a design, customize the brief and build in your AI tool. 75+ Markdown prompts + motion references. US$8.50, one-time purchase.

## Digital guide details

### Carousel Studio

URL: https://promptpack.tech/products/carousel-studio/
Category: Social content
Status: available through Razorpay checkout for ₹899 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets) or US$15 (international cards), paid once
Format: 29-page illustrated PDF guide, 28 editable prompts, worked example, starter files, worksheets

Design six-slide carousels with a cover that earns the swipe, then plan, approve and publish them. Six connected slides with a strong cover, relevant imagery and one practical next action, plus the caption, alt text and source ledger, packaged for approval and publishing. The design guide teaches the visual decisions; the workflow guide turns the finished carousel into a dated, approved handoff.

For: Creators, marketers and small teams who publish educational or news carousels and want a repeatable route from brief to post.
Requirements: A text AI assistant and an image generator (ideally one that accepts reference images), or a design editor for art-plus-typesetting. Node.js and Python for the optional local workflow tools. Image tools, accounts, credits and publishing access are separate.
Scope: Image generation needs your own tool, account and credits. The optional starter renderer only checks text fit; it does not generate illustrations. The workflow tools run locally: the Instagram publishing starter is mock-tested and needs your own Meta app, review and credentials. No hosted scheduler or automatic publishing is included, and the examples show an editorial process, not guaranteed reach or engagement.

Workshop steps:
1. Choose one reader and one job
2. Lock a system, not six layouts
3. Make the cover earn the swipe
4. Review the output, not the prompt
5. Separate draft, approval and publication state
6. Build the complete handoff package

First session:
1. Read GUIDE.pdf, then fill MASTER-BRIEF.md and collect verified source notes.
2. Study references with REFERENCE-WORKSHEET.csv, then run the staged prompts in PROMPTS.md to lock the visual system and storyboard six slides.
3. Generate one cover in your image tool, check it at phone size, then generate the interiors and review them with QUALITY-CHECKLIST.md.
4. Open workflow/START-HERE.md: give the carousel a post ID and owner, then run the planning prompts to build the approved handoff package.

Public tools referenced: python-pillow/Pillow (MIT-CMU (stated in upstream LICENSE; GitHub detected NOASSERTION)) https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow; microsoft/playwright (Apache-2.0) https://github.com/microsoft/playwright; Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill (MIT) https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill; postoncehq/instagram-mcp (MIT) https://github.com/postoncehq/instagram-mcp

Sample prompt:

Create a reusable style block for [APPROVED ANGLE + BRAND + REFERENCES]. Specify canvas and safe zone, palette roles with hex values, headline/body/metadata hierarchy, image medium, material, light direction, texture, connectors, source/page-marker positions and avoid list. State what remains consistent and what varies. Offer one recommended direction, then repeat its style block verbatim for use in every slide prompt. Do not treat one creator's profile as one universal visual style.

### UGC Ad Script Kit

URL: https://promptpack.tech/products/ugc-ad-scripts/
Category: Video
Status: available through Razorpay checkout for ₹699 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets) or US$12 (international cards), paid once
Format: 14-page illustrated PDF guide, 22 editable prompts, worked example, starter files, worksheets

Turn an honest product demonstration into a visually directed short ad. Make a 22-second product-demonstration plan with an evidence ledger, six visual boards, a recordable script and one clear next action. Approve the product facts before a presenter or image model performs them.

For: Solo sellers, creators and small teams planning product demonstrations.
Requirements: A product you can access, supplied product facts, rights-cleared presenter/media, an editor and optional AI tool access.
Scope: A planning and visual-direction kit, not a finished ad or synthetic-presenter service. Real product footage, presenter/voice/music rights, editor access and any AI accounts or generation credits are your responsibility. The optional Python storyboard utility requires Pillow and makes a simple planning sheet, not the six finished concept boards. No campaign publishing, factual product verification, legal clearance or sales guarantee is included.

Workshop steps:
1. Build a demonstration worth watching
2. Translate references into a style lock
3. Write a hook the body can pay off
4. Direct the shot and the presenter
5. Review what the viewer will believe
6. Hand off a controlled experiment

First session:
1. Read the six-board example and fill the master brief with one product task and supplied evidence.
2. Translate three inspected references into an original style lock; approve one hook and one prototype shot.
3. Use prompts 01-11 to produce the script, six scene briefs and presenter/recording handoff; rehearse with the real product.
4. Optional: run prompts 15-22 to turn the six briefs into AI video cuts with one style header and a blocking map, while every claim stays on real footage.
5. Optional: install the ugc-ai-ad-studio skill in Claude to run a reference-led AI ad through decode, reference sheets, stress test, one timed prompt, one take, a film finish in code and sign-off.
6. Run the quality gate, inspect the placement crop and export the approved files with captions, source ledger and a blank test plan.

Public tools referenced: huggingface/diffusers (Apache-2.0) https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers; Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill (MIT) https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill

Sample prompt:

Act as a product-demonstration director. For [PRODUCT], [AUDIENCE], [ONE VISIBLE TASK], [SUPPLIED FACTS WITH SOURCES] and [NEXT ACTION], write a one-page brief. Separate verified facts, fictional staging and missing evidence. Choose one observable demonstration and state what it cannot prove. Return a promise, production route, six scene jobs and explicit stop conditions. Do not invent experience, performance results, a discount or a destination.

### Juno & Pixel

URL: https://promptpack.tech/products/motion-with-code/
Category: Video
Status: available through Razorpay checkout for ₹1,499 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets) or US$29 (international cards), paid once
Format: 16-page illustrated PDF guide, 20 editable prompts, worked example, starter files, worksheets

Two-character 3D reels from a 100-word script, made entirely in code. Write a short two-character script and render a voiced, captioned vertical reel on your own computer. Use the included engine, ten original episodes and four reusable formats, then reskin a working copy for your own brand.

For: Creators and small businesses comfortable running local tools who want an original recurring character series.
Requirements: A computer, Node.js 20+, Python 3.10+, free local model/browser downloads and time to test and render. Coding assistance is useful for a new mascot.
Scope: The core uses free local tools after downloading models and a browser. You supply a computer, setup time, storage and electricity; rendering is not instant. Models, Python/Node runtimes and HyperFrames are installed separately. Ten new scripts are format-validated, not ten rendered movies. No MP4, paid API, hosting, publishing service or audience result is included.

Workshop steps:
1. Build a repeatable two-character show
2. Set up the free local production route
3. Direct voices, emotions and eyes
4. Choose the camera for the beat
5. Show proof and reskin the brand
6. Review, render and publish deliberately

First session:
1. Install the free local runtime, voice/model cache and browser, then run the script validator.
2. Inspect one original episode and its factual source; keep the supplied engine unchanged.
3. Prepare with the explicit-Parakeet wrapper, preview, then render one full episode on your computer.
4. Review the actual movie, measure its end-card hold and publish separately with one real CTA.

Public tools referenced: heygen-com/hyperframes (Apache-2.0) https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes

Sample prompt:

Create an original two-character series bible for [AUDIENCE] about [TOPIC RANGE]. Juno supplies a short problem and Pixel supplies a calm, bounded fix. Define character jobs, palette, end card, proof-panel rules and one CTA per episode. Openings must be eight words or fewer. Reject copied mascots, creator jokes, real-person impersonation and invented performance claims. Return a reusable bible plus five testable episode premises.
